KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:99/r5.anchor: Berzah kelimesi, –biri dünya hayatının son bulduğuna, diğeri âhiret hayatı için yeniden dirilmenin gerçekleştiğine işaret olmak üzere– iki defa üflenecek olan iki sûr arasında geçecek süre olarak da açıklanmıştır

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p282/r2.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p282/r2.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p282/r2.claim: The opponents persist in mischief until death, then awaken to the next world; their plea to return is futile because the time for action ended at death and a barrier lasts until resurrection.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p282/r2.anchor: The time of action for them will stand expired for it is restricted to the previous world only.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p282/r3.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p282/r3.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p282/r3.claim: An alternative reading takes the words to mean that the speaker may utter this plea but would repeat his former conduct if returned.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p282/r3.anchor: can also mean that this person may utter these words but if he is sent back, he will continue to do what he did earlier.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p282/r4.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p282/r4.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p282/r4.claim: Although parallel Qur'anic passages support the alternative, the author prefers the reading that the plea is regret which cannot avail the dead.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p282/r4.anchor: However, in my opinion, the interpretation I have adopted is the correct one.

BURHAN:v1p368/r1.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p368/r1.speaker: author
BURHAN:v1p368/r1.claim: The first class of Qur’anic كلا permits both pausing before it and beginning after it, depending on whether it is read as rebuke or confirmation; twelve examples are listed, including these four.
BURHAN:v1p368/r1.anchor: إحداها ما يجوز الوقف عليه والابتداء به

BURHAN:v4p315/r1.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v4p315/r1.speaker: الكسائي
BURHAN:v4p315/r1.claim: Al-Kisa'i takes kalla as haqqan, an emphatic confirmation; it is accusative as a verbal noun with an omitted verb meaning I affirm that as true.
BURHAN:v4p315/r1.anchor: تكون كلا بمعنى حقا عند الكسائي فيبتدأ بها لتأكيد ما بعدها

BURHAN:v4p315/r2.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v4p315/r2.speaker: author
BURHAN:v4p315/r2.claim: The confirmation sense is used only when kalla begins a statement to reinforce what follows, according to the leading grammarians.
BURHAN:v4p315/r2.anchor: ولا تستعمل بهذا المعنى عند حذاق النحويين إلا إذا ابتدىء بها

BURHAN:v4p315/r3.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v4p315/r3.speaker: أبو حاتم
BURHAN:v4p315/r3.claim: Abu Hatim says kalla is an opening particle meaning ألا; he adduces Gabriel's first five verses of al-Alaq, the pause after 96:5, and the later revelation beginning with kalla at 96:6.
BURHAN:v4p315/r3.anchor: فدل على إن الابتداء ب كلا من طريق الوحي فهي في الابتداء بمعنى ألا عنده

BURHAN:v4p315/r4.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v4p315/r4.speaker: author
BURHAN:v4p315/r4.claim: Here kalla means illa; some instead read it as haqqan, but that is unlikely because it would require fatḥ on inna, a reading nobody reports.
BURHAN:v4p315/r4.anchor: على معنى إلا واختار قوم جعلها بمعنى حقا

BURHAN:v4p315/r5.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v4p315/r5.speaker: author
BURHAN:v4p315/r5.claim: Kalla occurs thirty-three times in fifteen suras, with none in the first half of the Qur'an.
BURHAN:v4p315/r5.anchor: وجميع كلا في القرآن ثلاثة وثلاثون موضعا في خمس عشرة سورة

DAMGHANI:v1p282/r10.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p282/r10.speaker: author
DAMGHANI:v1p282/r10.claim: The righteous deed hoped for after death is interpreted as performing pilgrimage.
DAMGHANI:v1p282/r10.anchor: الصلاح الحج قوله تعالى في سورة المؤمنين لعلي اعمل صالحا فيما تركت اي أحج

DAMGHANI:v1p485/r2.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p485/r2.speaker: author
DAMGHANI:v1p485/r2.claim: وراء can mean before or ahead of someone; the barrier and the cited king or Hell lie ahead.
DAMGHANI:v1p485/r2.anchor: وراء بمعنى قدام قوله تعالى في سورة الكهف وكان وراءهم ملك يعني قدامهم

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p641#2/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p641#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p641#2/r1.claim: Yamīn can mean either an oath or the familiar bodily member opposite the left hand.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p641#2/r1.anchor: اليمين : تقال ويراد به الحلف . وتقال ويراد بها العضو المعروف

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p641#2/r9.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p641#2/r9.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p641#2/r9.claim: Ibn al-Jawzī selected material from earlier wujūh works, excluded unsuitable items, and added acceptable transmitted exegetical material.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p641#2/r9.anchor: فهذا آخر ما انتخبت من كتب الوجوه والنظائر التي رتبها المتقدمون

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p641#2/r10.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p641#2/r10.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p641#2/r10.claim: He deliberately retained some distinctions that a rigorous critic might combine, reasoning that merging them would erase most of the traditional categories.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p641#2/r10.anchor: وقد تساهلت في ذكر كلمات نقلتها عن المفسرين

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p641#2/r11.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p641#2/r11.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p641#2/r11.claim: He says comparison between chapters reveals the book’s value; its linguistic derivations are meant to sharpen understanding, and he asks God for benefit and sincere reward.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p641#2/r11.anchor: وما ذكرت في كتابي هذا من الكلمات اللغوية في اشتقاق الكلمة وما يتفرع منها

BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p191/r1.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p191/r1.speaker: author
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p191/r1.claim: Bint al-Shāṭiʾ urges reexamining particles called زائد: the bāʾ under discussion still retains its core attachment sense and directly governs the predicate, so its function deserves explanation.
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p191/r1.anchor: وتظل على أصيل معناها في الإلصاق، وتعمل عملها المباشر في الخبر ملصقة به غير معقول بزيادتها

BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p191/r3.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p191/r3.speaker: author
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p191/r3.claim: She cites the barzakh “behind them” alongside “from behind walls” as a parallel to her call to recover the rhetorical function of particles deemed extra.
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p191/r3.anchor: ومن النظائر قوله تعالى: {لَا يُقَاتِلُونَكُمْ جَمِيعًا إِلَّا فِي قُرًى مُحَصَّنَةٍ أَوْ مِنْ وَرَاءِ جُدُرٍ}

NASHR:v2p165/r3.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p165/r3.speaker: نافع وابن كثير وأبو عمرو وابن عامر وأبو جعفر
NASHR:v2p165/r3.claim: Nafiʿ, Ibn Kathir, Abu ʿAmr, Ibn ʿAmir, and Abu Jaʿfar use fatḥ on the final ya of لعلي in six occurrences across Yusuf, Taha, al-Muʾminun, al-Qasas, and Ghafir.
NASHR:v2p165/r3.anchor: واتفق نافع وابن كثير وأبو عمرو وابن عامر وأبو جعفر على فتح لعلي حيث وقعت

NASHR:v2p329#2/r5.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p329#2/r5.speaker: الكوفيون ويعقوب
NASHR:v2p329#2/r5.claim: The Kufans and Yaqub make sukūn on the single yāʾ of addition in لعلي أعمل.
NASHR:v2p329#2/r5.anchor: (وفيها من ياءات الإضافة ياء واحدة) لعلي أعمل أسكنها الكوفيون ويعقوب
